```{r, results='asis'}
# Metadata line (project dates)
meta <- c()
if ("{{start}}" != "" && "{{start}}" != "NA") {
  meta <- c(meta, format(as.Date("{{start}}"), "%b %Y"))
}
if ("{{end}}" != "" && "{{end}}" != "NA") {
  meta <- c(meta, paste0("– ", format(as.Date("{{end}}"), "%b %Y")))
} else if (length(meta) > 0) {
  meta <- c(meta, "– ongoing")
}
if (length(meta) > 0) {
  cat('<div class="project-meta">', paste(meta, collapse = " "), '</div>\n')
}
```
